create_text_to_video_parameters: create TextToVideoParameters with guidance_scale, negative_prompt, num_frames, num_inference_steps, and seed for video generation
create_text_to_video_input: create TextToVideoInput with a text prompt and optional TextToVideoParameters for text-to-video inference
create_text_to_video_output: create TextToVideoOutput from raw video bytes returned by the inference API
parse_text_to_video_output: parse a JSON or bytes response into a TextToVideoOutput instance using parse_obj
parse_text_to_video_output_list: parse a JSON array response into a list of TextToVideoOutput instances using parse_obj_as_list
